description.value: The Nitinaht Visitor Centre and General Store is a Ditidaht First Nation-operated facility at remote Nitinaht Lake on the west coast of Vancouver Island, one of the very few supply points in the area. It sits along the Vancouver Crossing Loop route and serves cyclists, hikers, and West Coast Trail users passing through this strikingly isolated stretch of old-growth country. The facility also functions as the orientation centre for the West Coast Trail's third entrance.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (nitinaht.com) is the official Ditidaht First Nation portal and its contacts page explicitly lists a 'Nitinaht Visitor Centre/General Store' with phone 250-745-3999, confirming a real publicly accessible retail/visitor facility at Nitinaht Lake. No OSM tags are present beyond the name and coordinates. No specific cycling amenities (bike parking, water, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all amenity fields default to null. The OSM name 'Nitinaht Lake Gas Station' differs from the website's 'Nitinaht Visitor Centre/General Store,' which is flagged as a concern; the general store function supports the Groceries category.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records this as 'Nitinaht Lake Gas Station' but the official website identifies the facility as 'Nitinaht Visitor Centre/General Store.' The gas station function is not confirmed by the website.
Phone number 250-745-3999 comes from the website, not OSM (OSM had no phone); used website value.
The website notes seasonal operation for the Visitor Centre/General Store; accessibility outside the tourism season is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible general store and visitor centre operated by the Ditidaht First Nation at Nitinaht Lake — one of very few resupply options on the Vancouver Crossing Loop in this remote corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The facility also serves as the West Coast Trail 3rd Entrance Orientation Centre and handles windsurf campsite inquiries, suggesting it is a meaningful hub for outdoor visitors in the area.

wow_evidence: Ditidaht First Nation-operated facility... West Coast Trail's third entrance
